allowedSourceMaterial.overview: The invasion of a village in Belarus by German forces sends young Flyora into the forest to join the weary Resistance fighters, against his family's wishes. There he meets a girl, Glasha, who accompanies him back to his village. On returning home, Flyora finds his family and fellow peasants massacred. His continued survival amidst the brutal debris of war becomes increasingly nightmarish, a battle between despair and hope.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Left alone in the wake of total devastation, how does Flyora endure as the brutal debris of war turns survival into a desperate struggle between hope and despair?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After German forces invade his Belarusian village, young Flyora defies his family to join Resistance fighters in the forest, only to return alongside a girl named Glasha and discover his community has been massacred.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Heavy, slow, and deeply immersive. A grueling wartime experience suited for solitary, focused viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Elem Klimov directs an immersive historical war drama that confronts the nightmarish reality of survival, balancing devastating emotional weight with deliberate visual rigor.
